provenance: Curated from the tight-junction structural literature (claudins + TJ scaffolds/adaptors). Manually assembled for this analysis; NOT a MSigDB export.
Claudin gene family (HGNC CLDN root symbols) — direct read-out of the "claudin program".
Desmosomal + adherens-junction components; included because GSE289287 pairs TACSTD2 KO with DSG2 KO.
Canonical type-I interferon-stimulated genes (core ISG module widely used in the IFN-I literature). Manually curated.
Canonical type-II (IFN-gamma) response genes: GBPs, IFN-g-inducible chemokines, MHC-II master regulator, JAK/STAT axis. Manually curated.
MHC class-I antigen-processing machinery (APM). Manually curated.
T/NK-cell cytotoxic effector transcripts used as a bulk-tumour surrogate for cytotoxic infiltration. Manually curated.
Broad lymphoid/myeloid infiltration markers (pan-immune presence in bulk tissue). Manually curated.
Immune-checkpoint ligands/receptors that are direct or proximal targets/biomarkers of checkpoint blockade. Manually curated.

18-gene Tumour Inflammation Signature (T-cell-inflamed GEP) as published by Ayers et al., J Clin Invest 2017 / Danaher et al. — used clinically as a pembrolizumab response correlate. Gene membership taken from that publication.
6-gene IFN-gamma signature (Ayers et al., J Clin Invest 2017) — the smaller of the two published pembrolizumab-response GEPs.
T-cell-recruiting chemokines; the mechanistic link between an epithelial barrier program and T-cell entry. Manually curated.
Core epithelial-to-mesenchymal-transition markers (both epithelial and mesenchymal poles listed; interpret with direction).
Epithelial identity / keratinisation transcripts, used to check whether barrier loss coincides with loss of epithelial identity.
NF-kB-driven inflammatory output; distinguishes generic inflammation from IFN-specific signalling.
The two genes at the centre of this analysis plus their closest paralogues (TACSTD1/EPCAM, CLDN3/CLDN7 co-regulated with CLDN4 in the 3q28/claudin-low axis).
